tablet.notes: Settings changes (Voicemail, Groups, dock side) apply to every screen at once. New layout: Messages Plus - tablet dock. Calls has a settings gear: Save the call log, Call and Message in the tap menu, Split screen. A group named on another tablet shows its name here. Voicemail shows the flip phone only when this tablet cannot reach Verizon itself.
